display.title: {"text": "Arcane Sites"}
description: Mage towers, citadels, pyromancer and ice-spider lairs, catacombs: Iron's Spells' own structures and Terralith's mage towers.
&ePrepare:&r Magic resistance (Iron's), mana regen, a way to fight casters at range.
&eSignature rewards:&r Scrolls and inks (upstream tables, unchanged), Ancient Cores in treasure, Iron's spell gear.
&eComing back:&r Iron's structures are spread far apart; the Dead King's catacombs are a one-time boss lair.
&eFeeds into:&r Magic route: scrolls -> spellbook; cores -> epic ink.
&eBrings home:&r The Hollow Roads expedition (Expedition Hall). Arcane essence is its contribution and powers the Spell Forge route.
&aDo:&r Walk into any arcane sites structure (mid game).
&6You get:&r Scrolls and inks (upstream tables, unchanged), Ancient Cores in treasure, Iron's spell gear.
